name: NotificationPreference
label: Notification Preference
description: Notifications a person turned off - one rule or all of them, in one channel or in every one. Made in the profile (Preferences → Notifications), from the bell and by the unsubscribe link in a letter; delete a row to send them again. Mandatory notifications ignore it.

fields.label: Email
fields.description: The person's email - a user's or any address a rule writes to.

fields.label: Notification
fields.description: Empty — all notifications (the digest too, for email).
